name: jevons-talking
description: Jev answers questions one menu pick at a time, through a word-prediction keyboard

scripts.talk: TYPESAFE_API_KEY="${TYPESAFE_API_KEY:-$(security find-generic-password -a "$USER" -s typesafe-jev -w 2>/dev/null)}" NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 node --import tsx talk.ts
scripts.talk:beam: TYPESAFE_API_KEY="${TYPESAFE_API_KEY:-$(security find-generic-password -a "$USER" -s typesafe-jev -w 2>/dev/null)}" NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 node --import tsx beam.ts
scripts.talk:hybrid: TYPESAFE_API_KEY="${TYPESAFE_API_KEY:-$(security find-generic-password -a "$USER" -s typesafe-jev -w 2>/dev/null)}" NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 node --import tsx hybrid.ts
scripts.bot: TYPESAFE_API_KEY="${TYPESAFE_API_KEY:-$(security find-generic-password -a "$USER" -s typesafe-jev -w 2>/dev/null)}" BLUESKY_APP_PASSWORD="${BLUESKY_APP_PASSWORD:-$(security find-generic-password -a jevons-talking.bsky.social -s bluesky-jevons -w 2>/dev/null)}" NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 node --import tsx bot.ts
scripts.jt: TYPESAFE_API_KEY="${TYPESAFE_API_KEY:-$(security find-generic-password -a "$USER" -s typesafe-jev -w 2>/dev/null)}" NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 node --import tsx jt.ts
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit -p . && biome lint && for f in *.ts docs/*.ts; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
